articles.title: Captain Saves Flydubai Flight After Terrorist Attack, Receives UAE Bravery Award
articles.description: Indian captain Smit Machchhar and crew thwart a hijacking attempt by Omani suspect Hamam al‑Hammami on a Flydubai flight, preventing a planned crash into Israel and earning the UAE's First Class Order of Zayed II.
